# Holdem Lab

> Open-source educational software for No-Limit Texas Hold'em. Run it locally
> with virtual chips. No real-money play, live-table assistance, or profit claims.
> The source repository is the durable entry point; a hosted trainer is not promised.

## Documentation

- [Source and setup](https://github.com/yorzi/holdem-lab): README, local prerequisites, and MIT license.
- [Product guide](https://github.com/yorzi/holdem-lab/blob/main/docs/product.md): Learning loop, current features, feedback and storage limits.
- [Local setup](https://github.com/yorzi/holdem-lab/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Rails, SQLite, Vite and React installation without cloud accounts.
- [Development](https://github.com/yorzi/holdem-lab/blob/main/docs/development.md): Code boundaries and verification commands.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/yorzi/holdem-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Scope, changes, source rights and tests.

## Limits

- Strategy feedback is approximate, not verified solver output or guaranteed optimal play.
- Browser-local reviews do not imply automatic cloud sync.
- Automated checks do not establish independent domain review or learning effectiveness.
- Original material is MIT licensed; external references and dependencies retain their own rights.
